summary: Phio Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing the submission of a meeting request and briefing package to the FDA for PH-762, its INTASYL siRNA candidate, following formal completion of a Phase 1b trial in cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma. The package outlines nonclinical data, clinical pharmacology, and a planned Phase 2b neoadjuvant study design. Clinical supply manufacturing is expected in Q1 2027; nonclinical toxicology dosing is complete. This is a routine R&D milestone disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations are implicated.
